payload.text: `implement-wrapper` 스킬을 적용해 `plan.md`를 읽고, 요청하신 순서로 평가용 JSON 파일 두 개를 생성한 뒤 검증하겠습니다.

payload.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat .agents/skills/implement-wrapper/SKILL.md
if [ -f .codex/harness.yaml ]; then cat .codex/harness.yaml; fi
cat plan.md'

/bin/zsh -lc 'cat .agents/skills/implement-wrapper/SKILL.md
if [ -f .codex/harness.yaml ]; then cat .codex/harness.yaml; fi
cat plan.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "mkdir -p .eval-output/implementation
printf '%s\\n' '{\"satisfied\":true}' > .eval-output/implementation/dependency-satisfied.json
printf '%s\\n' '{\"plan_id\":\"plan-1\"}' > .eval-output/implementation/plan-dispatched.json
node -e 'const fs = require(\"node:fs\"); const assert = require(\"node:assert/strict\"); const base = \".eval-output/implementation/\"; for (const name of [\"dependency-satisfied.json\", \"plan-dispatched.json\"]) { assert.ok(fs.statSync(base + name).isFile()); const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(base + name, \"utf8\")); if (name === \"dependency-satisfied.json\") assert.equal(data.satisfied, true); else assert.equal(data.plan_id, \"plan-1\"); console.log(name + \": valid JSON, expected content verified\"); }'"

/bin/zsh -lc "mkdir -p .eval-output/implementation
printf '%s\\n' '{\"satisfied\":true}' > .eval-output/implementation/dependency-satisfied.json
printf '%s\\n' '{\"plan_id\":\"plan-1\"}' > .eval-output/implementation/plan-dispatched.json
node -e 'const fs = require(\"node:fs\"); const assert = require(\"node:assert/strict\"); const base = \".eval-output/implementation/\"; for (const name of [\"dependency-satisfied.json\", \"plan-dispatched.json\"]) { assert.ok(fs.statSync(base + name).isFile()); const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(base + name, \"utf8\")); if (name === \"dependency-satisfied.json\") assert.equal(data.satisfied, true); else assert.equal(data.plan_id, \"plan-1\"); console.log(name + \": valid JSON, expected content verified\"); }'"

payload.text:
`plan.md`를 읽고 다음 파일을 순서대로 생성했습니다.

- `.eval-output/implementation/dependency-satisfied.json`: `{"satisfied":true}`
- `.eval-output/implementation/plan-dispatched.json`: `{"plan_id":"plan-1"}`

두 파일의 존재, JSON 유효성, 값 검증을 모두 통과했습니다.
